profiles.segment_name: Quick Bouncers / Casual Browsers (Low avg session duration sec (-0.53 SD) · Low avg items per session (-0.51 SD))
profiles.description: Short, low-interaction visits with minimal product depth and low cart activity.
profiles.recommended_action: Optimize landing-page speed, highlight top bestsellers, and simplify search filters.

profiles.segment_name: Focused Everyday Shoppers (High avg items per session (+0.33 SD) · High avg session duration sec (+0.30 SD))
profiles.description: Balanced session duration and steady product exploration near the population mean.
profiles.recommended_action: Offer relevant product recommendations and streamlined one-click checkout prompts.

profiles.segment_name: Hesitant Cart Abandoners (High cart abandonment rate (+2.66 SD) · High avg cart additions per session (+1.93 SD))
profiles.description: Customers who frequently add products to cart but leave without completing checkout.
profiles.recommended_action: Trigger exit-intent reminders, free-shipping thresholds, or time-limited cart incentives.

profiles.segment_name: High-Value Loyal Shoppers (High total sessions (+1.29 SD) · High total views (+1.01 SD))
profiles.description: Returning multi-session customers with deep exploration and strong conversion.
profiles.recommended_action: Enroll in VIP loyalty rewards, early-access drops, and cross-sell bundles.
